[G] Revision operations, retention, and generation
|
|-- Immutable operations               diagramRevision.ts
|   |-- createDiagram(input)
|   |-- reviseDiagram(base, edit)
|   `-- deriveDiagram(base, input, refs, sources)
|       |-- prepare and validate content + source context
|       |-- preserve proven logical node identities
|       `-- return frozen DiagramRevisionResult
|
|-- Runtime revision store             diagramRevisionStore.ts
|   |-- retainDiagramRevision(result) / importDiagramRevision(revision)
|   |-- getDiagramRevision(id) / listDiagramRevisions(diagramId)
|   `-- convenience commands
|       |-- createStoredDiagram / reviseStoredDiagram / deriveStoredDiagram
|       `-- submitStoredDiagramEdit
|
|-- Generation orchestration           application/core/diagrams
|   `-- generateDiagram(generator, request, options)
|       |-- obtain explicit base revision
|       |-- generator.generate(...)    asynchronous candidate generation
|       `-- submitStoredDiagramEdit    validate + issue + retain
|
|-- Supplied edits                     AgentChat / other callers
|   `-- submitStoredDiagramEdit(request, candidate, correspondence)
|       `-- validated supplied ASCII -> retained revision
|
`-- Canvas publication                 MappingDocumentController
    |-- apply semantic operations / install issued revision
    |-- CanvasHistory.append(...)      assert issued immutable payload
    |   `-- checkpoint binds diagram content to revision IDs
    `-- persistence adapters           flush referenced revision records

Content operations take explicit inputs; they do not access a store.
Retention is explicit; generation and canvas publication are separate steps.
DiagramRevisionEditor prepares edits and conservative identity correspondence.
Canvas history retains issued revisions and owns canvas checkpoints.

Sources: domain/core/diagrams/{diagramRevision,diagramRevisionStore}.ts
         application/core/diagrams/generateDiagram.ts
         domain/core/diagrams/{submitDiagramEdit,canvasHistory}.ts
